answer: At most 4 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a forge tag. The karst cap is applied at intake and ledge shows the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool thus cannot mint a fleet in one epoch regardless of capital it holds, because each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The deposit is 12 dollars a seat. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
